text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Like how she should run in a way that gets her more wins, or...
how it's such a waste when she clearly has the talent."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
—Still, I'm not changing who I am.
I don't want to change, and I can't change.
choice_data_list: And there's no need to change it either.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, you're right.
'There's no need to change it.'"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I like that!
It really clicked with me.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Then what I need to do is simple.
I'll just stay true to myself—and get stronger.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Next time I definitely wanna win and feel completely refreshed.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
If I'm going to win, it has to be a fierce, thrilling race.
Giving it everything I've got, racing through—and claiming victory.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Because unless it's that kind of race, I won't be satisfied!
